result_types.exact: User message equals the canonical quote text (character-for-character).
result_types.normalized: Only casing, punctuation, or apostrophe style differs; normalized tokens match the quote.
result_types.variation: Message uses a knowledge-base variation (often inside natural chat), not the canonical quote.
result_types.paraphrase: Natural near wording that fuzzy-matches the quote but is not the quote or a listed variation.
result_types.embedded: Full canonical quote appears naturally inside a longer chat message.
result_types.multi: One coherent message uses two quotes from the same source work.
result_types.cross_source: One coherent message uses quotes from at least two different works.
result_types.no_hit: Everyday message with no retrievable quote overlap.
result_types.near_miss: Thematic or lexical overlap without a valid quote match.
